checkRuns.command: pkill -f ".output/server/index.mjs"; bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun run check | tail -2; (PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 1.5; ACT=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4701/contact | grep -o 'action="[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f2 | sed 's/&/\&/g'); echo $ACT; curl -s -i -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:4701$ACT" -H "Referer: http://localhost:4701/contact" -H "Origin: http://localhost:4701" -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --data "name=+Bob+&email=bad&message=short" | head -20

bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun run check | tail -2; (PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 1.5; ACT=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4701/contact | grep -o 'action="[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f2 | sed 's/&/\&/g'); echo $ACT; curl -s -i -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:4701$ACT" -H "Referer: http://localhost:4701/contact" -H "Origin: http://localhost:4701" -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --data "name=+Bob+&email=bad&message=short" | head -20

bunx vite build --minify false 2>&1 | grep -i "error\|built in" ; ss -ltnp | grep 4701; cp /tmp/hd/test.ts ./.hd-test.ts && timeout 60 bun ./.hd-test.ts 2>&1 | grep -v "^    at" | head -60; rm ./.hd-test.ts
bunx vite build --minify false 2>&1 | grep -ci error; cp /tmp/hd/browser.ts .hd-browser.ts; grep -c KEEP .hd-browser.ts

cat > src/lib/slugs.ts <<'EOF'
// Slugs of the books collection, known synchronously on the server and in the browser.
// The glob is lazy, so no book content is loaded here.
const files = import.meta.glob("../../content/books/*.md", { query: "?raw" });

export const bookSlugs: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(
  Object.keys(files).map(path => path.split("/").pop()!.replace(/\.md$/, "")),
);
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/components/Layout.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('import { createAsync, useLocation } from "@solidjs/router";','import { useLocation } from "@solidjs/router";')
s=s.replace('import { getBooks } from "~/lib/books";','import { bookSlugs } from "~/lib/slugs";')
s=s.replace('  const books = createAsync(() => getBooks(), { deferStream: true });\n','')
s=s.replace('    return books()?.some(book => book.slug === slug) ?? false;','    return bookSlugs.has(slug);')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/app.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''          <Suspense>
            <Layout>
              <Suspense>{props.children}</Suspense>
            </Layout>
          </Suspense>''','''          <Layout>
            <Suspense>{props.children}</Suspense>
          </Layout>''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
sed -n 10,22p src/components/Layout.tsx; bun run check | tail -1; for p in $(ss -ltnp | grep 4701 | grep -o 'pid=[0-9]*' | cut -d= -f2); do kill $p; done; bunx vite build --minify false 2>&1 | grep -ci error; (PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &); sleep 1.5; ls .output/public/_build/assets/ | head -30

for p in $(ss -ltnp | grep 4701 | grep -o 'pid=[0-9]*' | cut -d= -f2); do kill $p; done; rm -f .hd-*.ts; bun remove happy-dom 2>&1 | tail -1; cat package.json; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -2 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -3; git status --short

printf -- '--- title: Aaa Test Book author: Test Author year: 1900 rating: 5 tags: [zeta] --- Hello **world**. ' > content/books/aaa-test.md; bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1; (PORT=4702 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4702 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &); sleep 1.5; curl -s localhost:4702/books | grep -o 'Aaa Test Book\|>zeta<' ; curl -s localhost:4702/books/aaa-test | grep -o 'world\|aria-current="page">Books'; curl -s localhost:4702/ | grep -o ''; for p in $(ss -ltnp | grep 4702 | grep -o 'pid=[0-9]*' | cut -d= -f2); do kill $p; done; rm content/books/aaa-test.md

bun run check 2>&1 | tail -1 && bun run build 2>&1 | grep -c "error"; (PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &); sleep 1.5; B=http://localhost:4701; for p in / /books /books/frankenstein /books/nope /about /contact /nope/deep; do printf "%-22s %s  %s\n" $p "$(curl -s -o /tmp/o -w '%{http_code}' $B$p)" "$(grep -o '<title[^>]*>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/o | sed 's/<[^>]*>//g')"; done; ACT=$(curl -s $B/contact | grep -o 'action="[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f2 | sed 's/&/\&/g'); rm -f /tmp/jar; curl -s -L -c /tmp/jar -b /tmp/jar -H "Referer: $B/contact" -H "Origin: $B" --data "name=&email=a@b&message=hi" "$B$ACT" | grep -o 'class="error">[^<]*' ; for p in $(ss -ltnp | grep 4701 | grep -o 'pid=[0-9]*' | cut -d= -f2); do kill $p; done; sleep 0.5; ss -ltnp | grep -c "470[12]"; git status --short content
